text:
Alex Kim: Hey team — I moved back to the US for 6 months and need to add my partner's child (age 7) to dental only. Child is not a US citizen and we only have an ITIN application pending. Can we add them midyear? do we need SSN? @Priya ?
Priya Rao (People Ops): Hi Alex — congrats on the move! Short answer: yes, you can add as dental-only for a QLE if you have supporting docs. We'll need proof of residency/move + proof of relationship/guardianship. ITIN pending is usually ok for enrollment; SSN preferred but not strictly required at submission time.
Benefits Bot: Reminder: QLE window = 30 days from qualifying event. Upload docs here: https://payroll.company.com/benefits/upload
Alex Kim: thanks — what specific docs for guardianship? kid's passport + temporary guardianship letter notarized?
Sam Patel (Benefits): Passport + school enrollment or medical record with US address usually works. If guardianship is temporary, a notarized letter + copy of caregiver's ID works too. If ITIN is pending, include ITIN application receipt (Form W-7) or IRS letter.
Alex Kim: any proration on dental premiums or effective date? payroll timing is messy while I'm onboarding.
Priya Rao (People Ops): Dental often becomes effective the first day of the month after we process docs, but we can backdate to the QLE date in some cases. Premiums will be prorated month of coverage. We need the QLE date and docs within 30 days to request backdate.
Alex Kim: Great. I'll upload scans now. Also — do we need to elect via the benefits portal or will you process on our behalf?
Sam Patel (Benefits): Please submit via the portal and tag @Priya. We'll confirm once processed. If you run into upload format issues, reply here with screenshots. :thumbsup:
Alex Kim: uploaded pdfs — 1 passport, 1 notarized caregiver letter, ITIN receipt. Tagging @Priya. Thanks!
Priya Rao (People Ops): Got them — we'll confirm by EOD and follow up if anything missing. If you need retro to QLE date, we'll request it with carrier. You'll get a confirmation thread once enrolled. :sparkles:
